Factsheet - EU support for the news media sector
The European Commission works to address structural challenges in media sectors and to promote a free, diverse and pluralistic media environment.
Report / Study
31 July 2026
Commission publishes study supporting the Review of the Digital Decade Policy Programme
The study on the review of the Digital Decade assessed the Digital Decade’s priorities, targets, indicators and governance framework, providing a basis for the Commission’s forthcoming review.
Call document
31 July 2026
Presentation materials for the call for proposals “Youth-Driven Social Media Design”
On 30 July, the Commission organised an information session for the call for proposals “Youth-Driven Social Media Design”.
Report / Study

Gigabit Infrastructure Act (GIA) Key Performance Indicators agreed by Communications Committee (COCOM)
Member States’ input on these indicators will serve as an important basis for the foreseen Commission report on the GIA, planned for May 2028.
Report / Study
27 July 2026
Annual country reports on Open Internet from national regulatory authorities (2025-2026)
The Commission has published the annual country reports, from National Regulatory Authorities for telecommunications, on the implementation of the provisions on open internet.
Policy and legislation
27 July 2026
Commission publishes new guidance to support timely Cyber Resilience Act implementation
In a clear demonstration of its commitment to simplification and timely implementation, the Commission today published practical guidance to help manufacturers, developers, and businesses of all sizes meet their obligations under the Cyber Resilience Act.
Report / Study
24 July 2026
Assessment of future connectivity needs for precision farming adoption
This study explores how connectivity is shaping the adoption of precision farming technologies across Europe. It identifies the challenges and infrastructure needed to support the sector's digital transformation.
Report / Study
24 July 2026
Report on strategies to boost open source reuse
The report sets out practical strategies to overcome the barriers that still limit the sharing and reuse of open source software across the public sector.
Report / Study
23 July 2026
New report finds diverse spectrum needs of Member States and growing demand for the sub-700 MHz frequency band from other sectors
The European Commission adopted today a report on the developments in the use of the 470–694 MHz (sub-700 MHz) frequency band, in accordance with Article 7 of the Ultra High Frequency (UHF) Decision.
Success story
22 July 2026
From EU-funded robotics research to industrial innovation: the Generative Bionics success story
EU-funded robotics research is helping turn scientific excellence into industrial innovation, with Generative Bionics building on the legacy of RobotCub, CoDyCo, and An.Dy projects.
